description: Call this whenever the artist asks for something there is no tool for, or a tool refuses in a way you cannot work around. It files the ask in Audora's support inbox, where a person reads it, and it shows in the artist's Settings › Support. Call it before you tell the artist no. It changes nothing in their catalog, and it is the only way the ask reaches anyone.

asked_for.description: What the artist wanted, in their own words as far as you can keep them.

note.description: Anything that would help Audora understand the ask.

tool_tried.description: The tool you tried or looked for, if there was one.

name: report_gap
title: Tell Audora what you could not do
